ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a complementary push-pull output stage powered by a single power supply +V_CC, the upper transistor VT1 is labeled as NPN, and the lower transistor VT2 is labeled as PNP; the two transistors converge on the right side to form the emitter output node A. A capacitor C_L is connected in series to the right side of node A, the other end of the capacitor is connected to the load resistor R_L, the lower end of R_L is grounded, and the output u_o is taken across R_L. Then reason: In the DC bias state with no signal, the output quiescent point of a single-supply complementary push-pull output stage is usually set at the midpoint of the power supply by the upper-lower symmetry relationship, so the DC potential of node A is V_A = V_CC/2. Since the right side of C_L is grounded for DC through R_L, the DC voltage maintained across C_L is the DC bias voltage of node A relative to the load side, namely V_CC/2. Therefore C_L is equivalent to a 0.5 V_CC DC voltage source.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, \( C_L \) is equivalent to a DC voltage source of ________ \(V_{CC}\).

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit structure from the image: complementary NPN/PNP transistors form an emitter output node A, and CL is in series from A to RL. For DC bias, use the symmetry of the push-pull stage between ground and +VCC: the no-signal voltage at A is set to mid-supply, VA = VCC/2. Since the load side is DC referenced to ground through RL and CL stores the DC offset between A and the load side, CL is equivalent to a DC voltage source of VCC/2, i.e. 0.5 VCC.

再推理：在无信号的直流偏置状态下，单电源互补推挽输出级的输出静态点通常由上下对称关系设置在电源中点，因此节点 A 的直流电位为 V_A = V_CC/2。由于 C_L 右侧通过 R_L 对直流接地，C_L 两端所保持的直流电压就是节点 A 相对负载侧的直流偏置电压，即 V_CC/2。所以 C_L 等效为一个 0.5 V_CC 的直流电压源。
